Interface TransactionStatus

All Superinterfaces:
Flushable, SavepointManager, TransactionExecution
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractTransactionStatus, DefaultTransactionStatus, SimpleTransactionStatus
public interface TransactionStatus extends TransactionExecution, SavepointManager, Flushable
Representation of an ongoing PlatformTransactionManager transaction. Extends the common TransactionExecution interface.

事务代码可以使用此功能检索状态信息，并编程式地请求回滚（而不是抛出导致隐式回滚的异常）。

包含 `SavepointManager` 接口，以提供对保存点管理设施的访问。请注意，仅当底层事务管理器支持时，才可用保存点管理功能。

Since:
27.03.2003
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

  • Method Details

    • hasSavepoint

      default boolean hasSavepoint()
      Return whether this transaction internally carries a savepoint, that is, has been created as nested transaction based on a savepoint.

      此方法主要用于诊断目的，与TransactionExecution.isNewTransaction()配合使用。若要程序化地处理自定义保存点，请使用SavepointManager提供的操作。

      默认实现返回false。

      See Also:
      • TransactionExecution.isNewTransaction()
      • SavepointManager.createSavepoint()
      • SavepointManager.rollbackToSavepoint(Object)
      • SavepointManager.releaseSavepoint(Object)

    • flush

      default void flush()
      Flush the underlying session to the datastore, if applicable: for example, all affected Hibernate/JPA sessions.

      这实际上只是一个提示，如果底层事务管理器没有刷新概念，则可能是一个空操作。刷新信号可能会应用于主资源或事务同步，具体取决于底层资源。

      默认实现为空，将刷新视为无操作。

      Specified by:
      `flush` 接口 `Flushable` 中
